description: Henter avgrenset oppdragsstatus og statusantall for én eksplisitt oppdrags-ID. Fritekst, klientmeldinger og jobbinnhold er utelatt.

oppdrag_id.description: Eksplisitt oppdrags-ID fra Revly. Oppslag uten ID er ikke tillatt.

name: hent_oppdrag_tilstand

outputSchema.description: Bounded status and counts for one engagement.

funn.description: Feilinformasjon counts per status. Not granskningsfunn. Use hent_funn for those.

antall.description: Number of misstatements in this group.

activity.description: Bounded status counts. No free text or job content.

budsjett_kr.description: Expected fee in kroner. Null when none is registered.

budsjett_timer.description: Hour budget. Null when none is registered.

delte_prosjekter.description: True when recorded hours include another engagement.

forbruk_prosent.description: Consumption in percent. May exceed 100. Null when the ratio is not this engagement or was never synced.

fort_kr.description: Recorded value in kroner. Null when it cannot be derived.

fort_timer.description: Recorded hours. Null when not synced, never a fake 0.

gjenstaaende_kr.description: Remaining value in kroner. Null when it cannot be derived.

gjenstaaende_timer.description: Hour budget minus recorded hours minus reserved hours. Null when hours are not a measurement.

kilde.description: Whether the percent comes from hours or from the fee.

mangler.description: Field names that are missing. Do not read them as zero.

reservert.description: Phase reservations. No person and no rate.

fase_kode.description: Phase code inside that map. The same code means different phases across maps.

fasekart_id.description: Phase map id: isa, regnskap or borevisjon.

sist_synkronisert.description: Last Tripletex sync time. Null when not synced.

tilstand.description: ikke_synkronisert when hours were never synced. That is not zero hours.

timesats.description: Derived kroner per hour, fee divided by the hour budget. Null when either figure is missing. Not a person rate.

budsjett.description: Budget and phase reservations. Null when nothing is registered. Missing figures are null, never a fake 0.

anyOf.description: Minimal evidence that this read was recorded.

client_receipt.description: Whether the connected client confirmed receipt. Revly reports "unknown".

result_produced.description: True when Revly produced the read result.

missing_sources.description: Sources with no record. Missing data stays visible and is never treated as a positive result.

operation_id.description: Revly operation ID for this read, recorded in the access log.

revly_url.description: Link to the engagement in Revly.

items.description: Source manifest entry: what contributed to the result and how current it is.

group_count.description: Grouped signature rows, for grouped sources.

source.description: Source that contributed to the result, for example oppdrag+klienter or forespoersler.

version.description: Latest version marker as text. Null when Revly has no version.

sources.description: Sources that contributed to the result.

truncated.description: True when the result was cut short.

title: Hent oppdragsstatus fra Revly
